page.layout: One block of running text, full width, justified, in one column. No margin notes. Catchword "sed" at the lower right. A faint mark at the lower left, and a vertical edge at the right, are not printed text.

main_text.p: rum dispendia, b[?]ostium compendia (ut cum Hieronymo dicam) & publica irae di-vinae incendia: Miseretur Dominus: me quidem miseret secundum Dominum: & quamuis iam absentem à Germania solo per voluntatem Dei, tamen ut præsen-tem animo graviter afficit istorum malo-rum, quæ video & prævideo, cogitatio. Atque his quidem malis provisurum con-fido Deum, & provisuros pios Principes amantes pacis publicæ & suæ, amantes pietatis, amantes patriæ. Sed quia tu, Mauricii Illustrissime, non postremus es in eorum numero, qui studio meditantur pacem, officio procurant, & exemplis (quibus abundas domi ab avo, à parente tuo) incitantur: non potui quin & Ger-manię communi vestræ & T. C. ani-mum meum constantem & studiosum vestræ pacis vobis exponerem à discessu meo. Scripsi de pace documenta commu-nia, quæ in mente sunt, in ore omnium; sed

page.notes: The first word of the page, "rum", is the end of a word begun on the previous page. Doubtful: the first letter of "bostium" (read as b, possibly h), marked [?]. The printed long s is rendered as f throughout and has been transcribed as s. The faint signature mark at the lower left is not transcribed. Possible show-through and edge marks at the right were left out.
